summary: 2027년 2월 졸업심사대상자(학사학위 수료자 포함)를 대상으로 영어졸업인증 대체특강 실시

en.title: [Academic Affairs] Guide to the Alternative Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification (Candidates for February 2027 Graduation)
summary: Alternative special lecture for English graduation certification offered to candidates for February 2027 graduation (including students who have completed all coursework, 학사학위 수료자)

Submission of an official English test score report (TOEIC, New TEPS, OPIC, etc.) below the passing score to the department office is mandatory by the application deadline; students without a submission record cannot apply
Application period: 2026.12.21(Mon) 09:00 to 12.22(Tue) 16:00 via the Inha Portal System
Lecture period: 2026.12.28(Mon) to 2027.01.08(Fri), conducted asynchronously online (recorded lectures and real-time quizzes)
Tuition is free, textbook must be purchased individually at the campus bookstore (certification granted based on evaluation results)
en.easyExplanation: This is a free alternative English graduation certification lecture for students subject to February 2027 graduation screening (including students who have completed all coursework, 학사학위 수료자) who have submitted an official English test score report to their department office. Students who have not submitted a score report are not eligible to apply. Applications are accepted on the Inha Portal from December 21, 2026, at 09:00 to December 22, 2026, at 16:00. The course runs online, and passing the evaluation grants English graduation certification.
en.target: Candidates for February 2027 graduation screening (including students who have completed all coursework, 학사학위 수료자). However, a record of submitting an official English score report (TOEIC/Speaking, New TEPS, OPIC, etc.) falling below the required standard to the department office by the end of the application period is mandatory; students without a submission record are not eligible to apply
en.eventInfo: Alternative Special Lecture for English Graduation Certification, conducted asynchronously online

나. 유의사항
(1) 수강인원이 편중(오전 또는 오후)되면 신청순서에 따라 임의로 분반배정 예정
(2) 평가결과(출석, 과제, 시험성적 등)에 따라 영어졸업인증 취득여부 판정
